newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks rise at opening.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks rise at opening.

text.p: U.S. stocks rose at Wednesday's opening on momentum from Tuesday's record close.

The Dow industrials were up 25 to 6,626 and the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite was up 0.33 to 1328.06 in the first 20 minutes of trade. The Standard & Poors 500 futures index was up 2.37 to 755.60 and the U.S. Treasury 30-year bond was up 4/32 to 6.78.
Traders could sell off later in the day amid profit-taking and nervousness about Thursday's jobless claims report and producer price index data, analysts said.
